<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="kmDSee2AsH9gu7wdxylM"> <mxGraphModel dx="977" dy="955" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam componentStyle uml2

node \"User Device (Smartphone)\" as Mobile {
 node \"React Native Environment\" {
 artifact \"EduCycle App\" as App
 }
}

node \"Google Cloud / Firebase\" <<Cloud>> {
 node \"Firebase Services\" {
 database \"Firestore (NoSQL DB)\" as DB
 component \"Firebase Auth\" as Auth
 component \"Cloud Functions (Node.js)\" as Logic
 storage \"Cloud Storage (Images)\" as Storage
 }
}

node \"External Platforms\" <<Cloud>> {
 component \"Firebase\" as Push
}

' Physical Connections
App --( HTTPS : \"API Calls / Auth\"
HTTPS -- Auth
HTTPS -- DB
HTTPS -- Storage
HTTPS -- Logic

' Server-to-Server
Logic -- Push

note right of App : Android / iOS
note bottom of Logic : Replaces traditional \nREST API server
@enduml","format":"svg"}" id="zDhfq32CVNw9n5LTui-7-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="678" width="899" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
